## [0.4.0-dev.72](https://github.com/alejandrobellver/pichiwa-patches/compare/v0.4.0-dev.71...v0.4.0-dev.72) (2026-07-21)

### New Features

* **whatsapp:** implement XML resource patching for network security config to allow MITM interception (overridePins) ([79df2e1](https://github.com/alejandrobellver/pichiwa-patches/commit/79df2e170af88e69177fed20a3b3d75443af731d))

patches.name: Anti Detector
patches.description: Bypass root, emulator, and custom ROM detection.

patches.name: Anti Edit
patches.description: Prevent others from editing sent messages.

patches.name: Anti Expiration
patches.description: Bypass WhatsApp forced version and expiration verification.

patches.name: Anti Revoke
patches.description: Prevent others from deleting their messages or statuses.

patches.name: Anti View Once
patches.description: View ephemeral media without limits and allow screenshots.

patches.name: Copy Statuses
patches.description: Allow copying text from contact statuses.

patches.name: Ghost Mode
patches.description: Do not receive or send messages while active.

patches.name: HD Media
patches.description: Send images and videos without compression.

patches.name: Hide Forwarded
patches.description: Quita la etiqueta "reenviado" de los mensajes.

patches.name: Hide Read Receipts
patches.description: Read messages without sending blue ticks.

patches.name: Login Fix
patches.description: Bypasses verification bans by spoofing signatures, installers, and faking GMS checks. REQUIRED: You must manually install microG-RE for Play Integrity to pass.
